answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 183108 Country: India Title: Gutkha business Question: I have gutkha business in Maharashtra, some ulama declare this business as haram, you should advise us. Answer ID: 183108 Posted on: Oct 30, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 291/232/B=3/1443) The business of gutkha is lawful, but it is khilaf-e-aula (not preferable). قال فى الشامي: وصح بيع غير الخمر أي عنده خلافًا لهما في البيع والضمان، لكن الفتوى على قوله في البيع، ثم إن البيع وإن صح لكنه يكره كما في الغاية . (شامي) Also see: Fatawa Rashidia, p. 401, Kifayatul Mufti vol. 9 p. 129, pub: Zakaria Deoband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
